name: controlflow-codex
description: Lightweight ControlFlow for native Codex: durable plan generation, inline adversarial plan verification, and plan-aware evidence review. 3 skills, 0 subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, verify, and review without duplicating native Codex
interface.longDescription: Preserves the useful ControlFlow layer on top of native Codex: durable schema-compatible plans with a standalone fallback, inline adversarial verification, and plan-aware evidence review. Codex keeps ownership of Plan mode, execution, approvals, sandboxing, subagents, generic review, and memories.
defaultPrompt: Use $controlflow-plan to create a durable plan for this non-trivial repository task.
Use $controlflow-verify to adversarially verify this saved plan before implementation.
Use $controlflow-review to compare this implementation with the approved plan.
